Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the credits by treating “songwriter(s)” as only lyricists and asserting “composer = Brian Green,” then incorrectly conflated the credited producer/songwriter Brian Green with actor Brian Austin Green, attempting to identify George Green as the father. This misreading of roles and entity mix-up diverted the task away from the straightforward interpretation (Miley Cyrus as a co-writer/composer, whose father is Billy Ray Cyrus).
